# CMUdict source

`cmudict.dict` is the Carnegie Mellon Pronouncing Dictionary, retrieved from
the official CMU Sphinx repository:

https://github.com/cmusphinx/cmudict

CMU describes the dictionary as free for research and commercial use and asks
that users acknowledge its origin. Kosmos uses it only as an offline English
word/pronunciation reference when drafting audiobook pronunciation candidates;
the narrator or author remains the final authority.
